title: How Many Elephants to BEAT Stockfish?
summary: Odds series vs Fairy-Stockfish level 8 (lichess-style UI): narrator has only king + N Elephants (rook + knight compound), +1 after each loss, vs the engine's full army on a 10x8 board. Loses with 1-6 elephants, wins with 7. Eval check afterwards: 4 elephants = -6, 5 elephants = +8 for the elephant side ('it takes Stockfish five elephants').
rules: Elephant: moves/captures like a rook or a knight.
Board is 10 files x 8 ranks ('actually 8 by 10, which was unfortunately a necessary adjustment').
Player: king + N elephants, no pawns; +1 elephant per loss.
Engine: full standard army (on a 10-wide board; extra two-file contents not established).
